title: Reporting Subscription Coverage
description: How one principal-level reporting subscription applies to one account (experimental, media_buy.reporting_subscriptions), returned in get_reporting_status. covered lists each buy's immutable covered_from so a buyer can derive the periods it is owed and tell a missing report (covered, period owed, nothing delivered) from a buy that was never covered. An account never silently drops out: loss of authority shows as unauthorized, and every uncovered account or buy appears in excluded with a reason.

ReportingSubscriptionExclusionReason.title: Reporting Subscription Exclusion Reason
ReportingSubscriptionExclusionReason.description: offering_unsupported: no offering matches the selector for this account or buy. unauthorized: the principal is not authorized for the account. overridden: a more specific subscription or sync_accounts delivery config replaces this one for the account and feed_purpose. capacity: beyond the seller's max_accounts or an account it will not serve. excluded_by_buyer: listed in exclude_account_ids.

status.description: Account-level status. active: the subscription serves this account; individual buys may still be excluded. excluded: the whole account is excluded, with an excluded entry that has no media_buy_id. unauthorized: the principal lost authority at unauthorized_at. action_required: the seller will serve the account only after pending_action completes.

unauthorized_at.description: When the principal's authority for this account ended. No data is delivered for periods ending after it.

pending_action.description: What must happen before the seller serves this account. Present when and only when status is action_required.

covered.description: Coverage intervals, one per (media_buy_id, offering_id, covered_from). A buy covered again after a re-grant gets a new entry with a new covered_from.

covered_from.description: Immutable. Every period ending after this instant is owed.

covered_until.description: End of coverage, when known: the buy's final period end, the end of the period in progress at deactivation, or unauthorized_at. Periods ending after it are not owed.

excluded.description: Accounts or buys this subscription does not serve. An entry without media_buy_id excludes the whole account.

overridden_by.description: The subscription or sync_accounts delivery config that replaces this one. Present when and only when reason is overridden.

withheld_unauthorized.description: Periods that ended before unauthorized_at but were not delivered by then. They are withheld, not missing, and never count as seller delay.

gaps.description: Intervals between loss of authority and re-grant that the seller did not backfill. Periods ending inside a gap are not owed.

examples.description: Account covered by an all-accounts subscription, one buy without a matching offering
Authority revoked: one owed period withheld, nothing new delivered
